purpose: Run four nonduplicating, source-bounded closure probes in parallel across LQG/spinfoam, CFS, asymptotic safety and RQCP without promoting any source-open object to terminal status.

source.title: Causal spinfoam vertex for 4d Lorentzian quantum gravity

LQG_SPINFOAM.machine_scope: Recompute c_n exactly from the finite polynomial and audit convergence to the published fixed-gamma large-spin coefficient. This is a Toller-building-block asymptotic audit, not a proof of causal-vertex finiteness or complete-stack convergence.

source.title: A Geometric Derivation of the Einstein Equations from the Causal Action Principle

source_objects.systematic_corrections: delta^3 and higher require non-optimal osculation analysis

CAUSAL_FERMION_SYSTEMS.machine_scope: Dimensionless order-counting diagnostic after introducing a characteristic macroscopic scale L: a nominal O(delta^3) term is one power epsilon=delta/L below an O(delta^2) term, modulo an explicitly scanned unknown dimensionless coefficient C3. This is not a source prediction for C3 and not an evaluated correction tensor.

source.title: Towards two-to-two scattering of scalars in asymptotically safe quantum gravity

source_objects.forward_boundary: at fixed t and s->infinity, A_t remains proportional to s^2/t; source states resolution requires A_4

ASYMPTOTIC_SAFETY.machine_scope: Recompute the source kinematic scaling and an explicitly labelled normalized adapted-RG diagnostic. No contact-complete amplitude is inferred.

RQCP.authority: repository-reproduced cutoff sequence from Iter342-343 and Iter394-398
RQCP.machine_scope: Refit the reproduced high-cutoff sequence under multiple lower-window choices and two asymptotic ansatz classes. Quantify inferred-limit model disagreement and window sensitivity. Numerical cutoff stability cannot by itself certify background-independent or all-band autonomy.
